== 00001.inc
// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

#version 3.7;

#include "colors.inc"

#declare n_pearl=
normal{
   radial sine_wave
   frequency 36*4
   rotate 90*z
}
#declare t_pearl=
material{
   texture{
     pigment {
       aoi
       color_map{
         [0 Wheat*.5+Coral*.5]
         [1 White]
       }
     }
     normal{n_pearl .05}
     finish{
       specular albedo .25 metallic roughness .025 diffuse .75 brilliance 2
       reflection{0,1 metallic}
       conserve_energy
       irid {
           0.35
           thickness .1
           turbulence .5
         }
     }
   }
}

#declare use_focal_blur = 7; // 0=off 1=low quality 10=high quality

camera {
  location < 250, 100, 0 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <-999750, 100, 2.22045e-10>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(42.9718)/2)*image_width/image_height))
  sky <0, 1, 0>
#if(use_focal_blur)
  aperture 5
  blur_samples 10*use_focal_blur
  focal_point <0, 120, 0>   confidence 0.9+(use_focal_blur*0.0085)
  variance 1/(2000*use_focal_blur)
#end
}

plane { <0, 1, 0>, 0
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <0.466667, 0.466667, 0.466667, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,0,0>
}

// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

#version 3.7;

#include "colors.inc"

#declare n_pearl=
normal{
   radial sine_wave
   frequency 36*4
   rotate 90*z
}
#declare t_pearl=
material{
   texture{
     pigment {
       aoi
       color_map{
         [0 Wheat*.5+Coral*.5]
         [1 White]
       }
     }
     normal{n_pearl .05}
     finish{
       specular albedo .25 metallic roughness .025 diffuse .75 brilliance 2
       reflection{0,1 metallic}
       conserve_energy
       irid {
           0.35
           thickness .1
           turbulence .5
         }
     }
   }
}

  location < 250, 100, 0 >

}
